diagnosis_text: Patient admitted for acute appendicitis with peritoneal irritation signs. Underwent laparoscopic appendectomy under general anesthesia. Hospitalized for 3 days with uneventful recovery. Discharged with oral antibiotics.

Patient diagnosed with acute cholecystitis confirmed by ultrasound showing gallstones. Performed laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Hospitalized for 2 days. Recovery uneventful, discharged in stable condition.
Patient requested rhinoplasty for cosmetic improvement of nasal bridge. Procedure performed under local anesthesia as outpatient. No complications. Follow-up scheduled in 2 weeks.

Patient presented with right knee anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) tear from sports injury. Underwent arthroscopic ACL reconstruction using hamstring autograft. Hospitalized for 2 days. Physical therapy rehabilitation plan initiated.

Patient admitted via emergency department with acute myocardial infarction (STEMI). Emergency percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) with stent placement performed. ICU stay for 3 days followed by 4 days in general ward. Total hospitalization 7 days.

Patient visited for annual comprehensive health screening including blood tests, chest X-ray, abdominal ultrasound, and cardiac stress test. All results within normal limits. No abnormalities detected.

Patient diagnosed with lumbar disc herniation at L4-L5 causing severe radiculopathy. Conservative treatment failed after 3 months. Underwent microdiscectomy. Hospitalized for 2 days. Significant pain relief post-surgery.

Patient presented with displaced fracture of right distal radius from fall. Underwent open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) with plate and screws. Hospitalized for 1 day. Cast applied, follow-up in 6 weeks.

Patient diagnosed with bilateral cataracts causing significant vision impairment. Underwent phacoemulsification with intraocular lens implantation on left eye. Outpatient procedure. Vision improved to 20/25 post-operatively.
Patient returned with post-appendectomy incisional hernia at previous surgical site. Underwent laparoscopic hernia repair with mesh placement. Hospitalized for 2 days. Recovery satisfactory.

Patient presented with severe osteoarthritis of the right knee unresponsive to conservative management. Underwent total knee replacement under spinal anesthesia. Hospitalized for 3 days. Physical therapy initiated on day 1 post-surgery.

Patient presented with multiple missing teeth requiring dental implant placement. Underwent surgical placement of 3 dental implants under local anesthesia. Outpatient procedure. Post-operative antibiotics prescribed.

Patient diagnosed with end-stage liver cirrhosis secondary to hepatitis B. Underwent orthotopic liver transplantation. ICU stay for 5 days post-transplant followed by 10 days in hepatology ward. Immunosuppression therapy initiated.

Patient admitted with acute appendicitis confirmed by CT scan. Underwent emergency laparoscopic appendectomy. Hospitalized for 2 days. Wound healing well at discharge. Oral antibiotics for 5 days post-discharge.

Patient with degenerative disc disease at multiple levels requiring spinal fusion surgery. Underwent posterior lumbar interbody fusion at L3-L4 and L4-L5. Hospitalized for 5 days. Significant improvement in mobility post-surgery.

Patient with advanced cataracts in right eye causing near-total vision loss. Underwent phacoemulsification with premium intraocular lens implantation. Outpatient procedure completed without complications. Follow-up in 1 week.

Patient requested comprehensive annual health checkup including full blood panel, ECG, abdominal ultrasound, cancer screening markers, and body composition analysis. All results within normal parameters. No pathological findings.

Patient with chronic knee pain and meniscal tear confirmed by MRI. Underwent arthroscopic knee surgery with partial meniscectomy and chondroplasty. Hospitalized for 1 day. Weight-bearing restricted for 2 weeks post-operatively.
Patient with recurrent tonsillitis and sleep apnea underwent tonsillectomy and adenoidectomy. Outpatient procedure under general anesthesia. Recovery unremarkable. Soft diet recommended for 2 weeks.

Patient with rotator cuff tear of the right shoulder causing significant functional limitation. Underwent arthroscopic rotator cuff repair with anchor fixation. Hospitalized for 1 day. Sling immobilization for 6 weeks.

Patient diagnosed with papillary thyroid carcinoma on fine needle aspiration biopsy. Underwent total thyroidectomy with central neck dissection. Hospitalized for 2 days. Thyroid hormone replacement initiated. Follow-up radioiodine therapy planned.

Patient with glioblastoma multiforme grade IV confirmed by MRI and biopsy. Underwent craniotomy with maximal safe resection of brain tumor. ICU monitoring for 3 days post-surgery followed by 7 days neuro ward. Adjuvant chemoradiation planned.

Patient required extraction of impacted wisdom teeth (all four quadrants). Underwent surgical extraction under intravenous sedation. Outpatient procedure. Post-operative swelling and discomfort managed with analgesics and antibiotics.

Patient with symptomatic right inguinal hernia causing intermittent bowel obstruction. Underwent laparoscopic hernia repair with mesh placement. Hospitalized for 1 day. Return to normal activities in 2 weeks.

Patient with end-stage hip osteoarthritis requiring joint replacement. Underwent total hip arthroplasty with cementless fixation. Hospitalized for 4 days. Physiotherapy commenced on day 1 post-operation. Discharged with walking frame.

Patient with medial meniscus tear and early osteoarthritis of the left knee. Underwent knee arthroscopy with partial medial meniscectomy. Outpatient procedure. Physiotherapy prescribed for quadriceps strengthening.

Patient requested cosmetic rhinoplasty to correct nasal asymmetry and improve tip projection for aesthetic reasons. Underwent open rhinoplasty under general anesthesia. Outpatient procedure. Splint applied for 10 days.

Patient presented to emergency with acute abdomen. CT confirmed perforated appendicitis. Underwent emergency open appendectomy with peritoneal lavage. ICU stay for 2 days followed by 4 days general surgery ward. IV antibiotics continued for 7 days.

Patient with chronic lower back pain underwent 10 sessions of physiotherapy and therapeutic ultrasound. No surgical intervention required. Functional improvement noted. Home exercise program established.

Patient with large kidney stone (15mm) in right ureter causing hydronephrosis and recurrent pain. Underwent ureteroscopy with holmium laser lithotripsy and DJ stent insertion. Outpatient procedure. Stent removed after 4 weeks.

Patient with colorectal cancer (T2N0M0) of the sigmoid colon. Underwent laparoscopic sigmoid colectomy with primary anastomosis. Hospitalized for 5 days. Pathology confirmed clear resection margins. Adjuvant chemotherapy not indicated.

Patient with symptomatic uterine fibroids causing menorrhagia and pelvic pressure. Underwent laparoscopic myomectomy with removal of multiple fibroids. Hospitalized for 2 days. Follow-up ultrasound in 3 months.

Patient with left breast cancer (stage II) confirmed by core needle biopsy. Underwent modified radical mastectomy with sentinel lymph node biopsy. Hospitalized for 3 days. Oncology referral made for adjuvant chemotherapy planning.
Patient with symptomatic gallstones and biliary colic. Underwent elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Hospitalized for 1 day. Post-operative course uneventful. Low-fat diet advised for 4 weeks.

Patient with obstructive hydrocephalus due to aqueductal stenosis. Underwent endoscopic third ventriculostomy. Hospitalized for 3 days. Symptoms resolved post-operatively. MRI follow-up scheduled in 3 months.

Patient with three-vessel coronary artery disease confirmed by angiography. Underwent off-pump coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) using left internal mammary artery and saphenous vein grafts. ICU for 2 days, ward for 5 days.

Patient with pterygium encroaching onto the cornea causing visual disturbance. Underwent pterygium excision with conjunctival autograft. Outpatient procedure under topical anesthesia. Eye drops prescribed for 4 weeks.

Patient with frozen shoulder underwent 8 sessions of corticosteroid injections and manual physiotherapy. Significant improvement in range of motion achieved. No surgical intervention required. Home exercise program continued.

Patient requested full executive health screening package including PET scan, cardiac CT angiography, full genetic cancer panel, and neurological assessment. No significant pathology detected. Report provided for personal records.

Patient with recurrent tonsillitis causing 6 episodes in the past year. Underwent elective tonsillectomy under general anesthesia. Outpatient procedure. Liquid diet for 2 weeks. No intraoperative or post-operative complications.

Patient with benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) causing urinary retention refractory to medical therapy. Underwent transurethral resection of the prostate (TURP). Hospitalized for 2 days. Catheter removed on day 1 post-op. Good urinary flow at discharge.

Patient with de Quervain tenosynovitis of the right wrist unresponsive to splinting and corticosteroid injections. Underwent surgical release of the first extensor compartment. Outpatient procedure. Splint for 2 weeks.

Patient with right carpal tunnel syndrome causing numbness and weakness. Underwent endoscopic carpal tunnel release. Outpatient procedure under local anesthesia. Return to light work expected within 2 weeks.

Patient with acute calculous cholecystitis, fever and elevated inflammatory markers. Underwent urgent laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Hospitalized for 2 days with IV antibiotics. Bile duct injury absent. Recovery uncomplicated.

Patient with perforated gastric ulcer presenting with peritonitis. Underwent emergency laparoscopic Graham patch repair. Hospitalized for 4 days with IV proton pump inhibitor and antibiotics. H. pylori eradication therapy initiated on discharge.

Patient with pancreatic head adenocarcinoma (stage IIa). Underwent pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple procedure). ICU stay for 4 days, ward for 10 days. Clear resection margins achieved. Adjuvant gemcitabine-based chemotherapy planned.

Patient requested blepharoplasty for cosmetic correction of sagging upper eyelids and under-eye bags for aesthetic improvement. Outpatient procedure under local anesthesia. No medical indication documented.

Patient with suspicious lung nodule (2.1cm) in right lower lobe. Underwent video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) with wedge resection and biopsy. Hospitalized for 3 days. Pathology confirmed pulmonary hamartoma, benign.

Patient with right axillary lymph node metastasis from primary breast cancer. Underwent right axillary lymph node dissection. Hospitalized for 2 days. Drain removed on day 2. Referred to radiation oncology for post-operative radiotherapy planning.

Patient with high myopia (-8.00 diopters) requested LASIK laser eye surgery for vision correction. Underwent bilateral LASIK procedure. Outpatient surgery suite. Vision corrected to 20/20 bilaterally. Post-op drops for 4 weeks.
